BETA Close X Sage Group PLC has purchased 302,695 of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases occurred on April 21, 2026, with prices ranging from 898.8000 pence to 920.0000 pence per share, and a volume-weighted average price of 910.9400 pence. All acquired shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 21 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026. Ordinary Shares Date of purchase: 21 April 2026 Number of ordinary shares purchased: 302,695 Highest price paid per share: 920.0000 Lowest price paid per share: 898.8000 Volume weighted average price paid per share: 910.9400 Sage will cancel all the purchased shares.
